title: 梅尔·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 深发精心盘整，金色面饰与珠宝呼应象牙白金色飘逸衣装。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Mel is an elegant dark-skinned adult woman with intricately arranged dark hair, distinctive golden facial adornments, gold jewelry, and flowing ivory-and-gold clothing. Preserve her refined Medarda identity and natural adult proportions with a fully covering high-neck long-sleeved robe and opaque lower layers. Restrained golden patterns may outline her hands as quiet decoration, without a weapon, targeting pose, or active magical barrage.
art_direction.scene: A slightly elevated complete figure, asymmetric curved silhouette, naturally separated hands and a small sunlit ground cue. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: rich brown, ivory, gold, jade shadow; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
